text:
Give the `--stage audit` preset a small structural fallback

**Symptom.** The combined audit preset runs portable task tests plus semantic gate. When a target has neither selected task tests nor a semantic contract, both assigned targets fail immediately with generic “no tests/no contract” evidence, while the more diagnostic defects—canonical rejection, zero profile support, missing rule binding, and transformation drift—appear only in a separate full battery. See `checks/audit/154382a9e3e8-combined/result.json`, `checks/audit/e08e27759d9d-combined/result.json`, and the corresponding `*-battery` summaries.

**Suggested change.** After a no-tests or no-contract result, automatically run a bounded structural fallback: lint, canonical `self_check`, profile-floor sample, and authority sync. Alternatively redefine `--stage audit` to include those four inexpensive stages before semantic analysis. This would preserve the fast preset while ensuring it returns at least one task-specific diagnostic rather than only missing-infrastructure failures.
